features: Smartshell with Auto Wake Sleep Flip case cover Designed specifically for Amazon All-New Kindle Paperwhite (all 2012, 2013, 2015 and 2016 versions) (Will not fit All-New Paperwhite 10th Generation 2018 Kindle or Kindle touch)
